content_html:
#Vangaveeti : genral ga RGV cinemalo Taking Camera Lights BGM Acting anii awesome untayi….okka story thappa. Essari Story guda undhi!!!

The beauty of RGV’s style is okaaa controversial subject tesukoni……..andhullo evaro okkalu hero inkollu villan annatu kakundaaa, Situations and Miscommunication ni Villan ga chupinchi migitha anni charachters neither hero nor villans anatu chupinchadam. No one can do that better than him!!!

BGM as usual migitha RGV movies laage will haunt you….dialogues again chala balanced gaa impact creat chesedatu unnayi

Cinema ni release kakunda cheyadaniki evaru ayithe godava chesaarooo…vaallaa meedha chala sweet n hot revenge terchukunaadu 😛 u will know it once u watch the movie!!!

Final ga Cinema motham oka ethu….last lo vacheeee dialogue oka ethu, that simply shows how geneius the master is 🙂
